params.prompt:
Image 1 is the scene. Keep it exactly as it is — same camera, same framing, same fixtures, same paper and palette.

Change ONE thing: the small television's dark screen is now lit and pale, and on it, drawn in the same graphite line as the rest of the picture, is the single word PROBLEM! in plain capitals across the top of the screen, with a jagged line falling from upper left to lower right beneath it, ending in a small arrowhead.

Hand-drawn animation pencil test: graphite line, visible construction lines, cross-hatch shadow, light coloured-pencil wash on props only, paper tooth showing — no flat vector fill, no digital gradients, no painterly rendering, no photographic lighting, no 3D.

The only text anywhere in the picture is the word PROBLEM! on the television screen.
